raw_comment:
We noticed that a lot of coastal states have fewer droughts, and the deep interior states like North Dakota, New Mexico, Texas, and Oklahoma have the most extreme drought. Northern states are also, contrary to expectations, experiencing significant drought.

We wonder how the widespread drought impacts agriculture.

The graph relates to us because the fire danger meter in Wisconsin has been at maximum for a really long time (around a year).

For our catchy headline, we came up with:
"Hey hey, ho ho, where did all the water go?"
